It would perhaps be intresting to count the average time the story stays with a certain character. I noticed that in The Gathering Storm the pov switches between all the characters quickly: at least every chapter or even multiple times in a chapter. In the earlier books the pov would stay on the same character for many chapters (sometimes with a short sequence about a minor character in between).
